svg.title: Only removing the capability reaches zero
svg.desc: A hand-drawn diagram: four differently-hachured input cards - trusted system prompt, semi-trusted user message, untrusted retrieved document and untrusted tool result - pour through a funnel into one uniform grey token stream, annotated that the model cannot see these colours and neither can you afterwards. A hostile IT NOTE hidden in the retrieved document is traced by a thick red path through the funnel and the model into the restart_service tool, labelled the confused deputy: your authority, their instruction. On the right, four amber barriers across the red path leak 33, 27 and 20 percent, while a much heavier green barrier with a padlock reads 'the tool is NOT in this agent's scope - 0% CATASTROPHIC'. A markdown image tag pointing at an attacker host is shown exfiltrating a secret off the page.
svg.text: Only removing the capability reaches zero
the model cannot see these colours.
Neither can you, after this point.
the confused deputy: YOUR authority, THEIR instruction
the tool is NOT in this agent's scope
rendering IS exfiltration. Strip it, or allow-list the host.
